name: Permanent Residence for Relatives up to the Second Degree

qualifying_event.description: For foreign relatives up to the second degree of consanguinity or affinity (parents, children, siblings, grandparents, grandchildren, and equivalent in-laws) of an Ecuadorian citizen, or of a foreign national holding permanent residence in Ecuador.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of the qualifying family relationship (birth/marriage certificates establishing the chain of consanguinity/affinity); proof of lawful means of subsistence.

requirements.blocker_text: Relationship up to the second degree of consanguinity or affinity with an Ecuadorian citizen or a foreign permanent resident of Ecuador (e.g. parent, child, sibling, grandparent, grandchild).
Must demonstrate lawful means of subsistence per Ministerial Agreement No. 70 (28 June 2024).

evidence_required.document: Documentary proof of the qualifying family relationship
Proof of lawful means of subsistence
